sanskrit: cannamalleśa nāmne || prathita yakaṃ sadvastu guru cidambara śivāyaikyarūpaṃ nitāntaṃ | prathita || 6 || upacārāṇi- sugandhākṣatān datvā || 6 || pūjalu || mantreṇa karpūra nīrājanaṃ vidhāya | tataḥ śubhrākṣatān datvā cinnidhaye | varṇarūpāya | sarvārthasādhakāya rucivyāpta ityantamuccaret ityādi ślokānubhavāḥ manana purassaraṃ smartavyāḥ || 10 || pūjalu || punarvibhūtiṃ dhārya vastraprāvaraṇaṃ kṛtvā || 12 || pūjalu || li"ngama"nge peṭikāyāṃ niveśayet || upacārāṇi
